keySentence: Pollyanna always found something to be glad about.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna moved to a new town. She met many people. She made them smile. Pollyanna always found something to be glad about.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna started her new life in the small town. The townspeople were surprised by her endless happiness. She visited a sick old woman who complained about everything. Pollyanna always found something to be glad about around her. She told the woman to enjoy the warm sunshine through the window. For the first time in years, the old woman smiled.
